description: Defines the PooledSharedImageVideoProvider class and related helper classes for managing shared images in GPU video processing on Android within the Chromium media project.

classes.name: PooledSharedImageVideoProvider
classes.description: Main class providing pooled shared image video management for Android GPU video processing.

classes.name: PooledSharedImageVideoProvider::GpuHelper
classes.description: Interface for GPU helper to process image returns on GPU thread.

classes.name: PooledSharedImageVideoProvider::GpuHelperImpl
classes.description: Implementation of GpuHelper that handles image return logic.

classes.name: PooledSharedImageVideoProvider::PendingRequest
classes.description: Represents a pending client request for an image.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new instance of PooledSharedImageVideoProvider with specified parameters.

methods.name: RequestImage
methods.description: Requests an image with specified specifications.

methods.name: OnImageCreated
methods.description: Callback when a new image is created by the provider.

methods.name: OnImageReturned
methods.description: Handles the event when an image is returned and no longer in use.

methods.name: ProcessFreePooledImage
methods.description: Processes a free pooled image to fulfill requests or discard.
